title: Voidcaller

canon_policy.notes: Ella, Rinna, Arion, Roland, the Abbot, the village, the Templar order, healing lore, religious institutions, creatures, cosmology, and plot remain source-bound. The 2012 creation date is useful provenance for authorial-ancestry comparisons, but similarity alone does not establish direct descent into later ArcSweep systems.

mechanisms.name: readiness-is-resource-bounded
mechanisms.description: Travel readiness depends on rest, food, warmth, wound state, equipment condition, and the condition of a trusted mount rather than determination alone.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Derive readiness from inspectable dependencies and maintenance receipts rather than one binary ready flag.

mechanisms.name: fear-prior-versus-observation
mechanisms.description: Community fear and institutional claims can cause ambiguous people or events to be interpreted as threatening before direct evidence is examined.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Keep rumour, doctrine, expectation, and fear-weighted interpretation separate from direct observation and verified state.

mechanisms.name: consent-before-care
mechanisms.description: The healer explicitly asks whether treatment is wanted before acting, even when she believes intervention is beneficial.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Support, repair, adaptation, or caretaker actions that change user state require an explicit grant when they exceed passive observation or already-authorised maintenance.

mechanisms.name: pattern-diagnosis-with-confirmation
mechanisms.description: A skilled observer infers likely cause from visible wound characteristics, then checks that inference with the patient rather than silently treating it as fact.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Diagnostic overlays expose observed features, candidate interpretation, and confirmation separately.

mechanisms.name: care-until-exit-criteria
mechanisms.description: Care continues until the patient no longer needs the healer rather than ending after one intervention.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Long-running support workflows remain open across treatment, follow-up, maintenance, and recovery until explicit exit criteria are met and receipted.

mechanisms.name: recovery-can-constrain-capability
mechanisms.description: Effective treatment may temporarily hinder movement while improving long-term recovery.
mechanisms.codex_translation: A healthy recovery state may intentionally narrow available actions; temporary constraint is not generic failure or loss of competence.

mechanisms.name: authority-label-versus-demonstrated-function
mechanisms.description: An institution labels a healer's effective practice illegitimate despite repeated observed benefit.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Keep authority claims, reputation labels, and demonstrated function in separate evidence lanes.

mechanisms.name: lineage-of-practice
mechanisms.description: Healing knowledge is passed through family teaching, practice, and remembered obligation.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Methods, brushes, rituals, recipes, and procedures may carry inspectable teaching lineage without lineage becoming automatic authority or canon.

mechanisms.name: ecology-binds-capability
mechanisms.description: A treatment depends on a specific moss that grows only in a particular cave location, tying capability to a material source and acquisition cost.
mechanisms.codex_translation: When a function depends on a specific dataset, model, file, sensor, material, or external service, show that dependency and its availability instead of presenting capability as self-contained.

laws: authority label is not measured function
diagnosis is not ground truth until evidence and confirmation support it
care that mutates state requires consent
recovery may reduce short-term capability without constituting failure
teaching lineage is provenance, not automatic authority
universal_codex_visual_ideas: readiness constellation showing rest, equipment, injury, companion, and environment as separate dependencies
rumour/doctrine/observation layers rendered with distinct provenance textures
diagnostic glyph that separates observed features from inferred cause
consent seal before repair or caretaker mutation
recovery ribbon that temporarily gates risky controls while displaying why
ingredient or dependency trail from a tool back to the source that makes it possible
prohibitions: Do not import Voidcaller story characters, institutions, religious claims, plot, creatures, or cosmology into ArcSweep canon.
Do not treat fear, gossip, doctrine, or institutional rank as direct evidence.
Do not let a diagnostic inference silently become fact.
Do not make caretaker intervention override explicit user agency.
Do not infer direct conceptual descent solely from thematic similarity; chronology is necessary but not sufficient.
